newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 16.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Monday's Daily Variety:
* Twentieth Century Fox's "Speed 2: Cruise Control" pulled in $16.2 million during its debut weekend.
* Two Wall Street firms, Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, recorded a notice of sale on DreamWorks' Playa Vista project.
* Residents who live next to Universal Studios Hollywood are balking at the company's latest plan: a family amusement park.

* Some Fox affiliates have suggested pulling the Fox Children's Network off broadcast television, concerned about lower ratings, spot ad sales and competition from News Corp's pending acquisition of the Family Channel.
* Media giants Leo Kirch and Bertelsmann AG may be close to a deal to combine pay-television networks Premiere and DF1.
